submission.justification: Radiator-R2 at 3.2 cm thickness provides the best pion/kaon separation performance at 10 GeV/c, achieving 4.652 sigma. Through systematic simulation testing across all three radiator candidates and thickness range from 1-6 cm, R2 at 3.2 cm emerged as optimal. R2 performs significantly better than R3 (best: 3.909 sigma at 3 cm) and R1 (best: 3.005 sigma at 3 cm). While R2 is a porous radiator which could raise durability concerns, the vessel is flushed with dry nitrogen during operation which provides environmental protection. All three candidates are explicitly listed as options and produced in required tile sizes, indicating they meet basic qualification requirements including lifetime performance. The goal prioritizes achieving the best possible separation, and R2 at 3.2 cm delivers a ~50% improvement over the next-best alternative.
